notes: All 12 views inspected. Crossbow with a shaped wooden stock, a leather grip wrap, a steel prod, a modelled string and stirrup, a trigger lever and a bolt seated in the groove. Small brass star inlays decorate the stock; these are decorative motifs, not a brand or maker's mark. The prod, stirrup and string are real geometry from every angle and the bolt is visible in the top view. Free-standing weapon, unrigged.
limitations: The string is static, so the crossbow cannot be re-cocked or fired without rigging.
The bolt is fused into the groove and cannot be removed.
method: Visual inspection of local-model renders and technical reports
